# Explain How You Resolved a Professional Conflict

[← Anthropic](../README.md) · [Every Anthropic question](../../anthropic.md) · [Read it on TrueInterview](https://trueinterview.io/study/explain-how-you-resolved-a-professional-conflict)

---

Tell me about a time you had a disagreement at work and how you handled it.
### Constraints & Assumptions
Draw from an actual conflict and represent the other person's perspective honestly. Describe how the decision was made and what followed.
### Clarifying Questions
Did the disagreement stem from facts, priorities, values, or ownership? What common objective did you share? Who held decision-making power? How did you adjust your own behavior?
### What a Strong Answer Covers
Concrete stakes, attentive listening, use of evidence or shared standards, a respectful outcome, and follow-through.
### Follow-up Questions
What if the final call didn't go your way? What would the other person say you handled well or badly? How did this experience shape future teamwork?
Overview:
Describe a workplace conflict by presenting both sides fairly, using shared criteria, a specific resolution process, personal changes you made, and follow-through.
